question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

PRIORITY
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e., 'precedence'. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Priority is a noun which the fact or condition of being regarded or treated as more important than others. (वरीयता).

 
 
• Example - The safety of the country takes priority over any other matter.
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• dignity - the state or quality of being worthy of honour or respect. (गौरव)
 
• formality - the rigid observance of convention or etiquette. (औपचारिकता)
 
• paucity - the presence of something in only small or insufficient quantities or amounts. (कमी)
 
• precedence - the condition of being considered more important than someone or something else; priority in importance, order, or rank.(प्रधानता)
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that precedence is the correct synonym for the word priority.
